01/09/2026
Logistics Concepts for the Saxon Lusatia Region
TU researchers are developing instruments to help the Saxon Lusatia region to transition from a lignite mining area to an international logistics hub and a tourist destination
11/08/2026
35 Years of Satellite Development at TU Berlin
A public lecture on 13 July 2026 will look back on 32 successfully launched satellites and the history of microsatellite research in Berlin at the Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics
07/07/2026
Power for Orbiting Satellites
Im Projekt „SpaceBox“ arbeitet das Fachgebiet Raumfahrttechnik der TU Berlin mit Berliner Industriepartnern an leichteren und leistungsfähigeren Energiespeichern für Satelliten
29/06/2026
Prof. Dr. Klaus Gramann receives the ERC Advanced Grant for Research on the Effects of Urban Environments on the Human Brain
“URBRAIN” investigates how urban environments influence stress, well-being, and long-term changes in the brain

See here for a list of dates of scientific defenses at our faculty. Scientific defenses are open to members of the University. You are usually required to register in advance.
